task_title: README release install snippet pins V=v0.2.0 after v0.3.0 shipped
task_criteria: README 'Install from a release' snippet pins V=v0.3.0 (current latest tag); asset names match real release assets off-by-one-v0.3.0-linux-amd64 + SHA256SUMS; no stale v0.2.x install pin remains

items.criterion: README 'Install from a release' snippet pins V=v0.3.0 (current latest tag); asset names match real release assets off-by-one-v0.3.0-linux-amd64 + SHA256SUMS; no stale v0.2.x install pin remains
items.detail: README.md:460 now reads `V=v0.3.0` (commit 657632b6 changed `-V=v0.2.0` / `+V=v0.3.0`). Asset names at README.md:462-463 are `off-by-one-$V-linux-amd64` and `SHA256SUMS`, which expand to exactly the real assets: the live SHA256SUMS downloaded from .../releases/download/v0.3.0/SHA256SUMS lists `56639ded...  off-by-one-v0.3.0-linux-amd64` (plus -linux-arm64 and both .tar.gz), and .coding-hermes/board/events.jsonl event 659 cut_verification_v0_3_0.assets_downloaded = ['off-by-one-v0.3.0-linux-amd64','off-by-one-v0.3.0-linux-arm64','off-by-one-v0.3.0-linux-amd64.tar.gz','off-by-one-v0.3.0-linux-arm64.tar.gz','SHA256SUMS']. v0.3.0 is the current latest tag: `git tag --sort=-v:refname` -> v0.3.0, v0.2.1, v0.2.0; `curl -sSIL .../releases/latest` -> HTTP 200 redirecting to /releases/tag/v0.3.0. No stale pin remains: `grep -c 'v0\.2' README.md` -> 0 (exit 1), `grep -n 'v0\.1' README.md` -> exit 1, and `grep -nE 'V=v0|VERSION=|TAG=v0|off-by-one-v0|releases/download' README.md` returns only lines 460-461.

items.criterion: The documented snippet executes verbatim against the real release: both curl downloads succeed, sha256sum -c verifies, and the binary reports v0.3.0
items.detail: Ran the block verbatim in a non-checkout dir (/tmp/ob1verify): `V=v0.3.0; base=.../releases/download/$V; curl -fsSLO $base/off-by-one-$V-linux-amd64; curl -fsSLO $base/SHA256SUMS; sha256sum -c --ignore-missing SHA256SUMS` -> output `off-by-one-v0.3.0-linux-amd64: OK`, exit 0; then `./off-by-one-v0.3.0-linux-amd64 --version` -> `off-by-one v0.3.0`, exit 0. Both asset URLs also return HTTP 200 on a HEAD request.

items.criterion: The pinned tag is the newest *published* release, not merely the newest local tag
items.detail: `curl -sSIL https://github.com/totalwindupflightsystems/off-by-one/releases/latest` -> `200 https://github.com/totalwindupflightsystems/off-by-one/releases/tag/v0.3.0`, i.e. GitHub's own latest-release pointer resolves to v0.3.0. Local ordering agrees: `git for-each-ref --sort=-creatordate` -> v0.3.0 2026-11-04 11:50:38 -0500 (newest), then v0.2.1, v0.2.0, v0.1.1, v0.1.0.

items.criterion: The fix is committed to the repository, not left as an uncommitted working-tree edit
items.detail: `git show HEAD:README.md | grep -n 'V=v0'` -> `460:V=v0.3.0`; `git status --porcelain README.md` -> empty output (clean). Commit 657632b6 'docs(readme): pin v0.3.0 in the release install snippet and repair the gitreins paragraph', merged at 2abdf0e9; its README diff is exactly the one-line pin change plus the README-10 paragraph repair.

items.criterion: No other forward-facing install pin in the README contradicts the new v0.3.0 pin
items.detail: `grep -nE 'V=v0|VERSION=|TAG=v0|off-by-one-v0|releases/download' README.md` returns only README.md:460 (`V=v0.3.0`) and README.md:461 (the base URL). Remaining v0.1.1/v0.2.0 strings in the repo are historical records outside the README — docs/dogfood/*, .coding-hermes/dogfood-log.md, and skills/off-by-one-usage/SKILL.md:595 which explicitly documents the old pin as a past defect ('The README's release recipe pins V=v0.1.1 ... DF-OFF-BY-ONE-60') — not forward-facing install instructions.

items.criterion: The docs-only change leaves the build, vet, gofmt and test gates green
items.detail: `go build ./...` exit 0; `go vet ./...` exit 0; `gofmt -l cmd/ internal/ pkg/ sql/` -> empty output (clean); `go test ./... -short -count=1 -p 1 -timeout 300s` exit 0 with every package ok (cmd/off-by-one 1.094s, internal/api 0.871s, internal/export 2.204s, internal/sandbox 1.284s, internal/solver 2.862s, internal/web 2.524s, pkg/api 0.035s). .gitreins/config.yaml defines no `test_command` key (guards.tests: false, go.tests: true), so the default Go suite was run.
